Company record: beat or topped its own guide in Q3'25, Q4'25 ($153M vs $149-152M), Q1'26 (-26% vs about -30%) and Q2'26 (-25%, top of range; EBITDA $13M vs $8-10M). The market knows this, since consensus sits slightly above the guide. Recent reactions are huge and set by the guide, not the quarter: -49% (02-25, Q1 guide -30%), -30% (06-02, Q2 guide), +26.5% (09-09, Q3 guide -5% and FY reinstated). The line it trades on is the Q4/FY guide and the IL MAKIAGE ad-account normalisation, not Q3 revenue.
view: This is a guide-driven, high-variance name going into a print where the Q3 number itself is mostly known. Management has beaten its own revenue guide in each of the last four quarters, and consensus already sits about $1M above the guide, so a small Q3 beat (-2% to -4%) is the base case and roughly priced. The reaction will turn on three things: whether the FY -19% is raised by more than the Q3 beat (which would mean Q4 better than -10%), whether repeat-order erosion at IL MAKIAGE stopped (it went from -15% to -20% in Q2), and any concrete news on fixing the ad account with its largest partner (the target already slipped from H2'26 to 2027 growth). Two things lean up. First, the stock gave back about 18% from its October high, including about 10% today with no company news, which lowers the bar and leaves 14% of the float short into a 20% implied move. Second, the company's habit is to guide conservatively. Two things lean down. The sell side is anchored below spot (mean target $16). Q4 faces a +24% comparison, so a Q4 guide around -10% would read as re-deterioration after Q3's -5%. There is also new Meta platform risk: 'product browsing' was default-on from 10-28 for funnels like IL MAKIAGE's quiz, and Similarweb shows METHODIQ visits -31% m/m in October, a single weak trace. Independent traffic traces are mixed and not decisive: ilmakiage.com visits +9% m/m in October and spoiledchild.com +3% (Similarweb), and Grips' Q3 sample decline is consistent with normal Q2-to-Q3 seasonality. Net, I see a mild upward tilt from conservative guiding and today's de-risked entry, but nothing dated that the price clearly does not hold.

recommendation.reason: Management's habit of beating its own guide is known and already in consensus, and the reaction depends on the Q4/FY guide and IL MAKIAGE commentary, which I have no independent read on. Today's unexplained ~10% drop and 14% short float tilt the setup up, but that is positioning, not evidence of an unpriced outcome. The probability does not reach the 65 needed to act.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: A FY26 revenue guide raised to about -17% or better (Q4 better than -8%), together with a dated statement that the IL MAKIAGE account is back to normal CPA, would make up likely and large. A Q4 implied at -10% or worse, or repeat orders worse than -20%, would make it a down print.

self_critique: The up case may be stronger than I credit: a conservative guider beating again, a Q4 guide near -8%, a 14%-short small float and a 10% drop into the print could easily produce another +20%. Calls are already priced richer, though, so the market leans the same way. The down case is also real: a Q4 -10% guide against a +24% comparison reads as re-deterioration, repeat-order erosion compounds, the sell side sits below spot, and nothing dated says the Meta account is fixed. Neither side has evidence the price does not hold, which is why I stay near 50.
